intentions.title: Keep Barkpark a headless CMS with one content model that stays fully operational with every plugin off
intentions.evidence: registry.ex Discovery kill-switch/whitelist (`:barkpark, :plugins`), Enablement.ex 'installed vs surfaced' two-layer contract, capabilities.ex core_nouns/core_commands comment 'Plugins OFF ⇒ exactly these nouns/commands are emitted', sheets.ex/github.ex moduledocs explicitly stating core machinery keeps working with the plugin off (fresh-install invariant).

intentions.title: Give every plugin one uniform behaviour contract (schemas, routes, workers, hooks, settings, CLI, desk items) so new domains bolt on without touching the host
intentions.evidence: Barkpark.Plugin behaviour implemented by bulldocs.ex, sheets.ex, github.ex, frt.ex, onixedit.ex, media.ex, tasks.ex, tickets.ex, pulse.ex, quiz.ex; registry.ex ResolverChain reduces resolve_* callbacks (action_handlers, doc_actions, cli_commands, desk_items, checkers, codelist_seeders, extract_edges, api_tests) uniformly across all plugins.

intentions.title: Expose one auth-tiered, existence-hiding capabilities manifest (`/v1/capabilities`) that is the single source of truth bp CLI and every SDK consume
intentions.evidence: capabilities.ex assembles core + plugin nouns/commands, default-deny visible?/2 ladder (none<read<write<admin, scoped_admin, ingest side branches), content-addressed etag, provenance stamping `source: plugin:<name>` on every plugin-contributed command.

intentions.title: Let a workspace admin turn plugins on/off and reposition them in the Studio desk without redeploying or touching plugin code
intentions.evidence: enablement.ex effective/1 merges compile-time declaration defaults (default_enabled?/structure_placement) with a per-workspace jsonb override at workspaces.settings['plugins']; fails closed to defaults on any lookup failure to avoid deadlocking the Registry GenServer.

intentions.title: Store and audit every plugin credential/setting encrypted at rest, with masked display and reveal auditing
intentions.evidence: settings.ex CRUD wraps writes/deletes/reveals in transactions paired with SettingsAudit rows and telemetry; settings_record.ex Cloak-encrypted storage; settings/masking.ex secret masker; github.ex settings_schema uses :password/:masked fields for private_key/webhook_secret.

intentions.title: Run lifecycle hooks (before/after save/publish/unpublish/delete) across all plugins safely — never let one plugin's bug break a document mutation or another plugin's hook
intentions.evidence: hooks.ex fire/2: before_* hooks run sequentially with halt-on-first-failure semantics, after_* run via Task.async_stream with 5s per-hook timeout and are fully rescued/caught so a raising plugin hook is logged and treated as :ok, never crashes the mutation path.

intentions.title: Bridge Barkpark tasks to GitHub Issues as an outbound mirror + inbound adopt flow, off by default until an operator provisions a GitHub App
intentions.evidence: github.ex: default_enabled? false, required_creds fail-closed validate_settings, register_workers gates Auth+DrainWorker on whitelist, register_routes for webhook/adopt/status/ops console, resolve_doc_actions surfaces an 'Adopt from GitHub' button only for content.github.state == 'intake' tasks.

intentions.title: Ship a first-party collaborative spreadsheet document type (Sheets) with strict structural/grid-bound validation enforced at save time
intentions.evidence: sheets.ex lifecycle_hooks before_save gate rejects non-A1 keys, out-of-bounds refs (col XFD/16384, row 1048576), oversized merges (merge_area_cap 10000), malformed conditional-format rules (cond_format_cap 200); register_routes exposes import/export/ops via the shared-secret :ingest bucket.

intentions.title: Cache plugin-derived collectors (action handlers, routes, top-menu entries) via a persistent_term snapshot so hot read paths never pay GenServer.call latency, while ctx-dependent collectors always run live
intentions.evidence: registry.ex moduledoc + refresh_snapshot/1: snapshot written only on register/2 mutation, read via :persistent_term.get with GenServer.call fallback; collect_desk_items_attributed/collect_checkers/collect_doc_actions explicitly documented as NOT cached because they vary per dataset/ctx.
